title: Context-Dependent Model Selection for Supply Chain Forecasting: Experiment Code
description: Source code accompanying the article "Context-Dependent Model Selection for Supply Chain Forecasting: A Multi-Case Comparative Study of Statistical and Machine Learning Methods". The repository implements a reproducible pipeline that compares classical statistical models (Naive, Seasonal Naive, ETS, ARIMA(X), SARIMA(X), Linear Regression) with machine-learning models (Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost, Deep FFNN, Shallow ANN) across four heterogeneous public supply-chain case studies, together with a representation-asymmetry analysis and a leakage-auditing protocol.
